text:
- Total revenue across all products was £25,218.52 TW, down 22.7% WoW from £32,627.63 LW, though up 37.6% YoY.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS generated the highest revenue at £5,701.16 TW with a 22.6% share, but declined 39.9% WoW.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT ranked second with £5,084.81 TW revenue and 20.2% share, experiencing a 52.4% WoW decrease from £10,687.69 LW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS achieved third place with £4,960.25 TW revenue and 19.7% share, surging 115.0% WoW from £2,307.01 LW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS showed the strongest year-over-year growth at 229.3% YoY, rising from £1,506.40 LY to £4,960.25 TW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER recorded the largest year-over-year decline at -45.9% YoY from £6,552.99 LY.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT generated the most orders at 105 TW, down from 123 LW.
